# Security Policy

[简体中文](SECURITY.md) | **English**

## Scope

- Tampered or unattributed files inside the distributed pack
- Credential leaks in the build script, release workflow or repository configuration
- Download URLs in the documentation replaced with malicious content

## Reporting

Use the "Report a vulnerability" entry on the repository Security page to file a private report, or open an issue that only states a security problem exists and asks for a private channel.
